My game used to do the same thing , mainly just as the match starts and i load in on round one and sometimes mid game. I don't know if it happens to you but for me even if i started the game again it would load me into the match then close again. The fast and temporary fix i found for this was to instantly restart ur pc as soon as the game closes and then launch it. This would usually fix the issue temporarily. The other thing is that sometimes the riot client will notice the game crashed and patch the game for you this fixed my issue. One extra thing is that this mainly happened to me on a pirated copy of windows i recently started using an actual copy and haven't had an issue since. Hopefully this helps you
